name_zh: 戈雷岛/奴隶贸易记忆：记忆导航修复与和解仪式
name_en: Goree Island/Slave Trade Memory: Memory Navigation Repair & Reconciliation Rituals
description_zh: 戈雷岛 (Gorée) 塞内加尔达喀尔近海，15-19 世纪大西洋奴隶贸易核心中转站，"无返之门" 象征非洲人被迫跨大西洋流离。核心记忆治理：联合国教科文组织世界遗产/戈雷岛博物馆/门户之旅/年度纪念/非洲侨民朝圣/记忆修复仪式(倾倒祭酒/呼唤名字/跨大西洋对话)。体现 M191 记忆导航修复——以"物理场所即记忆锚点+仪式即导航+侨民即见证+对话即修复"四位一体，在历史创伤/遗忘/否认中构建记忆正义与和解路径。
description_en: Goree Island off Dakar, 15-19th century Atlantic slave trade core transit point, 'Door of No Return' symbolizes forced African diaspora. Core memory governance: UNESCO World Heritage/Goree Museum/Door of No Return/annual commemoration/African diaspora pilgrimage/memory repair rituals (libation/name calling/transatlantic dialogue). Exemplifies M191 Memory Navigation Repair—quaternity of 'physical site as memory anchor + ritual as navigation + diaspora as witness + dialogue as repair' constructing memory justice & reconciliation path amid historical trauma/amnesia/denial.
reason_zh: 戈雷岛非单纯遗址，而是"物理门户+仪式导航+侨民见证+对话修复"四位一体记忆操作系统。"无返之门"作为物理/心理双重门槛，仪式引导访客/侨民完成记忆穿越，跨大西洋对话实现创伤对话。M191 区隔于 M154 梦境时间(澳洲)、M165 离散叙事(台湾)、M191 记忆修复(独特)，核心在于"物理场所锚定记忆+仪式导航穿越时空+侨民见证赋予尊严"的奴隶贸易记忆治理范式。
reason_en: Goree not mere site but 'physical door + ritual navigation + diaspora witness + dialogue repair' quaternity memory OS. 'Door of No Return' as physical/psychological double threshold, rituals guide visitors/diaspora through memory crossing, transatlantic dialogue enables trauma dialogue. M191 distinct from M154 Dreamtime (Australia), M165 Diasporic Narrative (Taiwan), M191 Memory Repair (unique), core: 'physical site anchors memory + ritual navigates spacetime + diaspora witnesses confer dignity' slave trade memory governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 物理场所锚定记忆：无返之门/奴隶屋/大炮/博物馆展品，物理空间即记忆锚点，零距离触摸历史创伤
仪式导航穿越时空：倾倒祭酒/呼唤名字/敲鼓/诵读/跨大西洋视频连线，仪式引导参与者完成记忆穿越/情感释放
侨民见证赋予尊严：非裔美国/加勒比/巴西/欧洲侨民朝圣/见证/叙事/艺术创作，侨民见证将受害者从数字还原为人
跨大西洋对话修复：非洲/美洲/欧洲学者/艺术家/活动家对话/赔偿/道歉/记忆共享/教育课程/联合国奴隶制纪念日
教育传承与数字化：戈雷岛学校课程/虚拟现实体验/数字档案/青年大使/记忆传承代际化
steps_en: Physical site anchors memory: Door of No Return/slave houses/cannons/museum exhibits, physical space as memory anchor, zero-distance touch historical trauma
Ritual navigates spacetime: libation/name calling/drumming/recitation/transatlantic video links, rituals guide participants through memory crossing/emotional release
Diaspora witnesses confer dignity: African American/Caribbean/Brazilian/European diaspora pilgrimage/witness/narrative/artistic creation, diaspora witness restores victims from numbers to humans
Transatlantic dialogue repair: African/American/European scholars/artists/activists dialogue/reparations/apology/memory sharing/education curricula/UN Slavery Remembrance Day
Education transmission & digitalization: Goree school curricula/VR experience/digital archives/youth ambassadors/memory transmission intergenerational
expected_zh: 以"物理场所锚点+仪式导航+侨民见证+对话修复"四位一体，在奴隶贸易历史创伤/遗忘/否认中构建记忆正义与和解路径，为大西洋奴隶贸易记忆治理提供全球范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'physical site anchor + ritual navigation + diaspora witness + dialogue repair' constructs memory justice & reconciliation path amid slave trade historical trauma/amnesia/denial, providing global paradigm for Atlantic slave trade memory governance.
